obfuscation_indicators: will not have a material adverse effect
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, including occupancy, collections, acquisitions, losses, and pandemic-related impacts. Its tone is predominantly confident and promotional, although COVID-19 uncertainty, unrealized securities losses, margin debt, and non-GAAP comparability introduce meaningful risks. Some boilerplate and forward-looking language softens or qualifies these risks.
